bagPolicy.summary: State Farm Arena allows bags smaller than 14" x 14" x 6" and does not enforce a clear bag policy. All bags are subject to screening.
allowed: fashion backpacks smaller than 14" x 14" x 6"
prohibited: All bags larger than 14" x 14" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags accompanying a child are exempt from the size requirement but are subject to search.

parking.note: State Farm Arena offers multiple parking options with varying proximity to the venue. Pre-purchasing parking through ParkMobile guarantees a spot and the lowest prices. Options include the Sapphire Deck, Ruby Lot, State Farm Drive, and Diamond Deck.

concessions.note: State Farm Arena offers a diverse range of food and beverage options, featuring local Atlanta favorites like Chick-fil-A, Dolo's Pizza Co., and J.R. Crickets. New offerings include a BBQ Smashburger and a Black Bean Burger, with a focus on quality, speed, and sustainability.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Fully ADA accessible. Wheelchair seating on all levels. Elevators, ramps, and accessible restrooms.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office on-site, check event details for hours. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Multiple entrances, check ticket for specific gate. Located at 1 State Farm Drive, Atlanta.
